name: davebben-skills
description: Dave's personal collection of Claude Code plugins, one per area of life. Install the ones you want. The SDLC plugin takes an engineering change from a vague ask to a verified production change; more areas (finance, learning, fitness) are on the way.

plugins.name: SDLC
plugins.description: Engineering practice run with the human rather than recited at them. The deliver loop agrees the outcome, the first decisions, a module map and the story list with the user, confirms each story's criteria as it starts, then runs it unattended through failing tests, a build subagent, a three-pass review, the full suite and a pull request into main, choosing each next story from what is ready. Around it: orient, story-map, story, next-story, test-plan, review-build, merge-request, spike, greenfield, give-feedback, guardrails, make-rule and adr. The user, not the model, makes every judgment call.

plugins.name: context
plugins.description: Skills for managing an agent session's context across boundaries. Today it hands a session over when context fills or work stops partway, recording the dead ends a fresh session would otherwise rediscover.

plugins.name: meals
plugins.description: Skills for eating to numbers without cooking from a spreadsheet. It builds reusable meal templates: a recipe the user already makes, paired with a fixed add-on that closes the gap to a calorie ceiling and protein and fiber floors, proven as a real dish before it is proven as macros, then written back to the recipe manager with ingredients that scale. It then plans days of meals from those templates, stretching batch dinners across days, checking daily averages against targets, and writing the meal plan and a shopping list to the recipe manager.
